title: 국군수송사령부령 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Establishment of Departments and Units)
(1) The Command shall have staff departments to assist the Commander in performing his or her duties and units under the Commander.
(2) Matters concerning the establishment and allocation of duties of staff departments under paragraph (1) shall be determined by the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, and matters concerning the establishment, missions, and organization of units subordinate to the Command shall be determined by the Minister of National Defense.
